text: Accept stablecoin payments from customers by enabling the Crypto payment method
quote: Start accepting stablecoins by enabling the Crypto payment method.

text: Completed stablecoin payments settle in the merchant's Stripe balance in local fiat currency
quote: Stablecoin payments allow you to accept stablecoins from customers around the world... completed payments settle in your Stripe balance in your local currency.

text: Supports USDC on Tempo, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon and Base, plus USDP and USDG on named networks (US-only)
quote: USDC (Tempo, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, and Base networks), USDP (Ethereum and Solana, US-only), USDG (Ethereum, US-only)

text: Full and partial refunds are supported for stablecoin payments
quote:
Refunds / Partial refunds

  [Yes / Yes](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/stablecoin-payments.md#refunds)

text: Minimum stablecoin payment amount is 0.01 USDC
quote: For stablecoin payments, the minimum amount is 0.01 USDC.

text: Stablecoin subscriptions (private preview) authorize recurring stablecoin withdrawals from customers' crypto wallets
quote: Stablecoin subscriptions (Private preview): Authorize recurring stablecoin withdrawals from your customers’ crypto wallets.

text: Stablecoins in Treasury (public preview) lets businesses receive, store and send funds globally in a Stripe Financial Account
quote: Stablecoins in Treasury (Public preview): Receive, store, and send funds globally with stablecoins in your Stripe Financial Account.

text: Eligible businesses can hold a USDC or OUSD stablecoin balance, including in markets where fiat Treasury isn't available
quote: A stablecoin balance, held in OUSD or USDC. Eligible businesses can hold a stablecoin balance in the countries where it's available

text: Create virtual or physical cards to spend funds held in the stablecoin financial account
quote: Create a virtual or physical card to spend funds

text: Connect platforms can pay out to connected accounts in stablecoins (USDC first) while the platform balance stays in fiat
quote: Stablecoin payouts let your Connect platform make payouts in stablecoins, starting with USDC. Your platform balance stays in fiat currency, while Stripe handles conversion and payout.

text: Connected accounts that link a crypto wallet in the Express Dashboard immediately get a USDC balance
quote: After a user links a crypto wallet in the Express Dashboard, they immediately see a new USDC balance on their connected account.

text: Issue virtual or physical prepaid cards for connected accounts backed by stablecoin balances (private preview)
quote: Stablecoin-backed card issuing with Connect (Private preview): Issue virtual or physical prepaid cards for connected accounts, backed by stablecoin balances.

text: Stablecoin-backed card programs for users, contractors and employees, usable anywhere Visa or Mastercard is accepted
quote: Enable spending with a stablecoin-backed card program. Available globally, anywhere Visa or Mastercard is accepted.

text: Global Payouts can send payouts to third parties in more than 160 countries
quote: Send payouts to third parties in more than 160 countries worldwide.

text: Send stablecoins to any external crypto wallet via Global Payouts
quote: Global Payouts: Send stablecoins to any external crypto wallet.

text: Send stablecoin payouts to Link users
quote: Payouts to Link: Send stablecoin payouts to Link users.

text: Fiat-to-crypto onramp lets customers buy cryptocurrencies directly from your platform or dapp at checkout
quote: The Stripe fiat-to-crypto onramp lets your customers securely purchase and exchange cryptocurrencies directly from your platform or decentralized application (Dapp) at checkout.

text: Stripe-hosted onramp redirects customers to a standalone checkout page
quote: Use the Stripe-hosted onramp to redirect your customer to check out in the standalone page.

text: Embedded onramp lets customers buy crypto directly within your website
quote: Use the Embedded onramp to let your customers check out directly in your website.

text: Embedded components onramp via mobile SDK lets customers buy crypto inside your app
quote: Use the Embedded components onramp (mobile SDK) to let your customers check out directly in your application.

text: Stripe is merchant of record for onramp transactions and takes full liability for fraud and disputes
quote: Stripe acts as the merchant of record for these onramp transactions and assumes full liability for all fraud and disputes.

text: Stripe handles regulatory requirements, KYC verification and sanctions screening for onramp transactions
quote: Stripe acts as the merchant of record for these onramp transactions and assumes full liability for all fraud and disputes. We also handle all regulatory requirements, know your customer (KYC) verifications, and sanctions screening.

text: Supports stablecoin payments over the x402 protocol
quote: Stripe also supports stablecoin payments over the x402 protocol.

text: Machine payments let AI agents pay for APIs and services programmatically
quote: Machine payments let agents pay for APIs and services programmatically.

text: Bridge Open Issuance lets you launch your own branded, fully backed stablecoin
quote: Bridge's Open Issuance platform lets you launch your own, branded fully-backed stablecoin you control.

text: Earn revenue from the treasury reserves backing your issued stablecoin
quote: Generate revenue from treasury reserves backing your stablecoin.

text: Bridge API supports on-ramp, off-ramp and crypto-to-crypto flows programmatically
quote: Programmatically support on-ramps, off-ramps, and crypto-to-crypto flows.

text: Static templates give customers persistent deposit instructions they can reuse
quote: A static template provides persistent deposit instructions your customers can use repeatedly.

text: Bridge offers a sandbox environment for testing integrations without moving real money
quote: Bridge has a sandbox environment for you to quickly begin testing your integration without having to move real money.

text: Bridge webhooks deliver real-time notifications of account events
quote: Bridge webhooks allow you to receive real-time notifications when events occur in your Bridge account.

text: Official Stripe MCP server gives AI agents tools to interact with the Stripe API
quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API

text: Stripe CLI can provision an anonymous sandbox with working API keys without account registration
quote: run the command `stripe sandbox create --help` to provision an anonymous Stripe sandbox with working API keys. No account registration required.
